import Mathlib

structure BipartiteGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BipartiteGraph.well_formed (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.size (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.has_edge (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BipartiteGraph.is_valid_coloring (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array Bool) : Prop :=
  colors.size = g.size ∧
  ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v →
    u < colors.size → v < colors.size → colors.getD u false ≠ colors.getD v false

def BipartiteGraph.is_bipartite (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ colors, g.is_valid_coloring colors

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_precond (graph : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def validB (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (colors.size = g.adj.size ∧
    ∀ u ∈ List.range g.adj.size, ∀ v ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList,
      ¬ (v < colors.size) ∨ colors.getD u false ≠ colors.getD v false)

def allLists : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 => (allLists n).map (false :: ·) ++ (allLists n).map (true :: ·)

def findColoring (g : BipartiteGraph) : List (List Bool) → Option (Array Bool)
  | [] => none
  | l :: ls => if validB g l.toArray = true then some l.toArray else findColoring g ls
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def check_bipartite (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  findColoring graph (allLists graph.adj.size)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_postcond (graph : BipartiteGraph) (result : Option (Array Bool))
    (_ : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some colors => graph.is_valid_coloring colors
  | none => ¬ graph.is_bipartite
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem validB_iff (g : BipartiteGraph) (c : Array Bool) :
    validB g c = true ↔ g.is_valid_coloring c := by
  simp only [validB, decide_eq_true_eq, BipartiteGraph.is_valid_coloring,
    BipartiteGraph.has_edge, BipartiteGraph.size]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, hall⟩
    refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
    intro u v he hu hv
    rcases hall u (List.mem_range.mpr he.1) v (by simpa using he.2) with h1 | h2
    · exact absurd hv h1
    · exact h2
  · rintro ⟨hs, hall⟩
    refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
    intro u hu v hv
    by_cases hlt : v < c.size
    · refine Or.inr (hall u v ⟨List.mem_range.mp hu, by simpa using hv⟩ ?_ hlt)
      rw [hs]
      exact List.mem_range.mp hu
    · exact Or.inl hlt

theorem mem_allLists : ∀ (l : List Bool), l ∈ allLists l.length := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [allLists]
  | cons b t ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons, allLists, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
    cases b
    · exact Or.inl ⟨t, ih, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨t, ih, rfl⟩

theorem findColoring_some (g : BipartiteGraph) :
    ∀ (ls : List (List Bool)) (c : Array Bool),
      findColoring g ls = some c → validB g c = true := by
  intro ls
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    intro c h
    simp [findColoring] at h
  | cons a ls ih =>
    intro c h
    simp only [findColoring] at h
    by_cases hv : validB g a.toArray = true
    · rw [if_pos hv] at h
      injection h with h'
      exact h' ▸ hv
    · rw [if_neg hv] at h
      exact ih c h

theorem findColoring_none (g : BipartiteGraph) :
    ∀ (ls : List (List Bool)),
      findColoring g ls = none → ∀ l ∈ ls, validB g l.toArray = false := by
  intro ls
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    intro _ l hl
    simp at hl
  | cons a ls ih =>
    intro h l hl
    simp only [findColoring] at h
    by_cases hv : validB g a.toArray = true
    · rw [if_pos hv] at h
      simp at h
    · rw [if_neg hv] at h
      have hv' : validB g a.toArray = false := by simpa using hv
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hl with rfl | hl'
      · exact hv'
      · exact ih h l hl'
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem check_bipartite_postcond_satisfied (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) :
    check_bipartite_postcond graph (check_bipartite graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold check_bipartite_postcond check_bipartite
  cases h : findColoring graph (allLists graph.adj.size) with
  | some c =>
    show graph.is_valid_coloring c
    exact (validB_iff graph c).mp (findColoring_some graph _ c h)
  | none =>
    show ¬ graph.is_bipartite
    rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    have hs : c.size = graph.adj.size := hc.1
    have h2 := mem_allLists c.toList
    have hlen : c.toList.length = graph.adj.size := by simp [hs]
    rw [hlen] at h2
    have h3 := findColoring_none graph _ h c.toList h2
    rw [show c.toList.toArray = c from by simp] at h3
    rw [(validB_iff graph c).mpr hc] at h3
    exact Bool.noConfusion h3
  -- !benchmark @end proof
